senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; כָּלָה)perfection.—Pl. מִכְלוֹת, מִי׳; מ׳ זהב (vessels) made of pure gold.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 29a:5">Men. 29ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>מ׳ זהב</he>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 4:21">II Chr. IV, 21</cite>) <he>שכילתו לכל זהב וכ׳</he> it used up all the locked up gold of Solomon.
